answer_1.quote: We consider two tasks: summarization, common in alignment research, and open-ended dialog generation, with substantial real-world relevance.

answer_3.quote: Importantly, we also include two zero-shot-prompted evaluation models with much larger backbones—GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) and PaLM-2-L.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we also perform human evaluations by self-reported native or advanced speakers, though only for a subset of language pairs and 250 (RL) / 100 (best-of-n) instances per pair due to its cost.
answer_4.guideline: For both human and LM evaluation, we elicit pairwise judgments to compare responses from the aligned model and the SFT model.
